summary: Iteration 5 — Payment (Bayar) step of /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx tested end-to-end via mobile-viewport Playwright (390x844) against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All requested behaviors verified: (1) Labels are 'Total Belanja', 'Uang Diterima', 'Kembalian'/'Kekurangan'. (2) Smart quick-nominal chips auto-generate from total: for total Rp 6.000 the chips rendered are 'Uang Pas', Rp 6.000, 7.000, 8.000, 9.000, 10.000, 25.000, 50.000, 100.000 — exact match of the +Rp1.000 steps then ceilTo(base,10k/25k/50k/100k), deduped and sorted. Tapping quick-Rp 100.000 set cash to exactly Rp 100.000 (change Rp 94.000). Formula also matches the requested Rp 15.000 example. (3) Underpayment allowed: entering Rp 5.000 with total Rp 6.000 shows 'Kekurangan Rp 1.000' in red, 'checkout-short-banner' visible with 'Pembayaran kurang Rp 6.000', confirm button stays enabled and label becomes 'Simpan (Bayar Sebagian)'. (4) Cash>=total: Uang Pas sets exact Rp 6.000, change 'Kembalian Rp 0' green, button label 'Selesaikan Transaksi'. (5) checkout-confirm-button successfully POSTs /api/transactions in BOTH underpaid case (cash Rp 1.000, tx saved, receipt shows Tunai Rp 1.000, Kembali Rp 0 — change stored as 0) and fully-paid case (Tunai Rp 6.000, Kembali Rp 0). Success screen (Transaksi Berhasil) + ReceiptPreview renders in both flows. (6) Numpad numpad-1/000/5/back all work; Uang Pas sets exact total. (7) No regressions on cart step or Transaksi tab. Two harmless legacy console warnings observed ('props.pointerEvents deprecated', 'useNativeDriver not supported').
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx suggestions: when total is already a round 1.000 multiple (e.g. total 6.000), the first suggestion equals total, so both 'Uang Pas' and 'Rp 6.000' chips do the same thing. This is per the requested formula (matches the Rp 15.000 example the user provided) and thus intentional, but consider hiding the duplicate for polish.

confirmPay uses Math.max(0, change) for the stored change (correct — no kembalian when underpaid) but cash_paid is stored as the raw underpaid amount. Backend accepts this without a paid/underpaid flag; consider adding a status field if reporting later needs to distinguish partial payments.
seed_data_creation: Two real transactions were created against the live backend during the flow verification (both used product 'mitubaby tisu basah', Rp 6.000). Receipt IDs visible in screenshots (#F00156 underpaid, #812168 fully paid). Main agent may want to delete these test transactions if the report data must remain clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment step tested with mobile viewport 390x844. To reach pay step: cari-barang-button -> cari-input 'mitubaby' -> tap first cari-row -> tap first cari-var -> cari-done -> bayar-button. Chip testIDs follow pattern 'quick-Uang Pas' and 'quick-<rupiah(n)>' (e.g. 'quick-Rp 6.000'). numpad testIDs are 'numpad-1'..'numpad-9', 'numpad-0', 'numpad-000', 'numpad-back'. Change/short banner testIDs: checkout-change-display, checkout-short-banner. Confirm: checkout-confirm-button. Backend POST /api/transactions works for both underpaid and fully-paid.
